items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Isn’t it interesting, the technology has changed so much. You probably remember Ray Shiner? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes, he was a wonderful man.

ctx.x: Yeah. I do. I try to fill in as best I can. And I get a lot of requests on the show and it’s good for me because I look for something that I wasn’t aware of before being available. Very good. And I’ve had good luck in finding sources to buy stuff. There are some good LP places that I lean on, in San Francisco, I go out there and I love them. It’s like being in a candy store, it’s unreal. I grab this and grab that, and the suitcase is full coming back.
Isn’t it interesting, the technology has changed so much. You probably remember Ray Shiner?
Oh yes, he was a wonderful man.
